<STBG 5,0><BGM 0,0,504><MWT 5><COL FEEB4EFF>At <COL FEEB4EFF>Tanbaki Coast</COL> a squall struck us.
Perhaps a <COL FEEB4EFF>Melynx</COL> prank.
A squall on the sands was unexpected.

<MWT 4>We pitched a tent and
decided to spend the night.

<MWT 4>The rain let up and we stepped outside
to find ourselves somewhere else
entirely from where we entered.
<MWT 4>What in the world was that phenomenon...
